nodes.label: MLIR-AIE (mlir-aie)
nodes.description: Xilinx MLIR-based AIE dialect project. Required dependency for AIE backend support in MLIR-AIR.

nodes.label: LLVM/MLIR
nodes.description: Core LLVM and MLIR infrastructure used as foundation for MLIR-AIR compilation.

nodes.label: XRT (Xilinx Runtime)
nodes.description: Xilinx Runtime for hardware execution on Ryzen AI and VCK5000 platforms.

nodes.label: AIR_ENABLE_AIE build option
nodes.description: CMake option (default ON) enabling AIE backend support. Requires mlir-aie dependency.

nodes.label: AIR_ENABLE_GPU build option
nodes.description: CMake option (default OFF) enabling GPU/ROCDL backend support.

nodes.label: airgpu runtime library
nodes.description: Native GPU runtime library (libairgpu.so) built when AIR_ENABLE_GPU is enabled. Contains GpuTestUtils.
